how: UFLY Skydiving Club ran a cylindrical vertical wind tunnel with two-minute sessions (2014 report); simulated freefall and current operation unconfirmed.
Long Beach Tower in Baoshan has a bungee-style vertical free-fall jump from platforms 12-19 m high inside a vertical adventure park; no open-air bungee site found.
venue: Long Beach Tower vertical adventure park

how: Bihai Jinsha Water Park in Fengxian has a Rixen cable system, hosts IWWF World Cup stops and national championships, and is used for wakeboarding courses.
Hot-spring style bathhouses and resorts exist (Oriental Spring bathhouse with trucked-in spring water, Sun Island Forest Spa in Qingpu), but there is no natural geothermal spring in the metro area.
Japanese-style onsen baths are offered at Hyakumangoku Onsen Hotel near Bicester Village and at hot-spring hotels such as Oyado; the water is not from a natural geothermal source.
Ski and snowboard simulators are in malls across the city, e.g. Rossignol Mountain Sports Academy at Taikoo Hui; over 100 simulators reported citywide.
